patterns.note: The hero section features a full-bleed, highly detailed, repeating animal pattern background that contrasts with a clean, centered content card.

A limited primary palette of black and off-white is accented by a specific set of soft pastel colors (orange, green, light pink, light yellow, light blue) used for distinct feature cards and illustrations.

A compact sticky header navigation bar reveals by sliding down from the top of the viewport once the user scrolls past the initial hero content, while the hero's patterned background remains largely static or subtly parallaxing.
Consistent use of custom, simple line-art illustrations accompanies feature descriptions and callouts, maintaining a cohesive and playful visual style throughout the page.
Large, bold, and often centered headings are paired with a clean, readable body text and small, uppercase labels for emphasis, creating a clear typographic hierarchy.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed, highly detailed, repeating pattern background that remains fixed or subtly parallaxed using CSS transforms as the main content scrolls over it, creating a layered depth effect.
A compact, functional navigation bar is initially hidden and then slides into view from the top of the viewport using CSS keyframes once the user scrolls past the initial hero content.
Feature sections utilize a grid layout where each card has a distinct, soft pastel background color and a custom line-art illustration, providing visual segmentation and a playful tone.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, and often centered headings (~3-4x body) with clean, readable body text and small, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 8-12px) consistently applied to buttons, input fields, and content cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing overall, with a slightly airy feel in the hero and feature sections, using generous vertical padding between main content blocks.

standout: The most distinctive element is the highly detailed, playful, black-and-white animal pattern used as a full-bleed background in the hero section, which creates a unique brand identity that is both whimsical and professional. This is combined with a clean, minimal content presentation and custom line-art illustrations.
